proposals.name: Bay Area Urban Debate League — Tournament Schedule
proposals.why: Already publishing the full 2026-27 tournament calendar with explicit middle-school divisions — the single best recurring debate feed for Dhruv.
proposals.eligibility_note: Page states tournaments are for both High School and Middle School students; only High School youth travel the National Circuit. Season opens 2026-10-03 (workshop) and 2026-10-17 (first tournament).

proposals.name: Stratagem Learning — on-campus middle school competition debate
proposals.why: Non-profit that runs the competition speech & debate team on Dhruv's own campus (Pine Valley MS), plus Iron Horse and Windemere Ranch.
proposals.eligibility_note: Elementary and middle school; a prior-season page listed Pine Valley practice Tuesdays 4:00-6:00pm. Could NOT fetch-confirm — strtgm.org failed DNS resolution from this run, so the live URL and current-season details need manual confirmation before adding.

proposals.name: City of San Ramon — Youth Sports Classes (HotShot Badminton)
proposals.why: City-run badminton at Iron Horse Gymnasium, five minutes away and the cheapest entry point into the sport.
proposals.eligibility_note: HotShot Badminton listed for all skill levels (beginner through advanced); coverage elsewhere describes ages 7-14, which fits Dhruv at 11. Registration routes to secure.rec1.com. Also lists Table Tennis ages 10-18.

proposals.name: US Badminton Academy (Livermore) — Class Schedule
proposals.why: Dedicated academy ~20 min away with a real competitive ladder, not just a rec class.
proposals.eligibility_note: Junior Beginner tier is ages 6-14 (Dhruv fits at 11), 12 classes across skill levels, weekday evenings 4:30-8pm plus weekends, roughly $230/mo once weekly. Elite Competition / Pre-Competition teams exist but details are not posted online.

proposals.name: Bintang Badminton — Classes (Dublin CA location)
proposals.why: Six-court Dublin facility (6780 Sierra Ct) — nearest full badminton club to San Ramon, with year-round kids' classes and team training.
proposals.eligibility_note: Classes run on a monthly basis for kids and adults of all ages/levels; team track requires a minimum of three practices per week and coach evaluation. Specific age brackets and times are not published — needs an email or call.

proposals.name: Junior Achievement of Northern California — Middle School Programs
proposals.why: The only free, local, age-appropriate financial-literacy and entrepreneurship curriculum found for a 6th grader.
proposals.eligibility_note: Grades 6-8 fit: JA Economics for Success (6-8), JA It's My Business, JA Company Program Pop-Up (6-12), JA Finance Park Virtual (7-12). IMPORTANT GATE: these are school-delivered (classroom / after-school / virtual), not open family enrollment — the practical move is asking Pine Valley MS or the PTSA

proposals.name: BayAreaScience.org — regional science events calendar
proposals.why: Week-by-week aggregated calendar of Bay Area science talks, star parties, festivals and museum events with prices listed — highest-yield single feed for one-off finds.
proposals.eligibility_note: All ages; mixed free and paid. Not teen-filtered, so a weekly scan needs a relevance pass.

proposals.name: Bay Area Teen Science (B.A.T.S.) — Berkeley Engineering outreach portal
proposals.why: Aggregates teen STEM programs, lab volunteer slots, career panels and application deadlines across the Bay Area in one place.
proposals.eligibility_note: Spans grades 3-12, with most listings aimed at high school — good fit for Ridhi. Live listings include dated deadlines (e.g. a Girls Who Code Pathways deadline of 2026-08-26) so it rewards a weekly scan.

proposals.name: Lawrence Hall of Science — Teen Research Programs
proposals.why: Hands-on research in UC Berkeley labs including biotech/genetics tracks — squarely on Ridhi's bio/medicine path, and Dhruv ages into it next year.
proposals.eligibility_note: Middle school track is entering grades 7-9; high school track is entering grades 10-12. Ridhi qualifies now; Dhruv qualifies for summer 2027 (entering 7th). Registration opens very early — members 2025-11-12, public 2025-12-10 for the 2026 cycle — and many sessions sold out, so the real action date

proposals.name: Hack Club — Bay Area high school hackathon list
proposals.why: Continuously updated roster of free student-run hackathons with dates and cities — the fastest way to catch new Tri-Valley events.
proposals.eligibility_note: High school (grades 9-12); Ridhi eligible, Dhruv is not. Caution: listed dates and cities have disagreed with organizers' own registration pages (see Fire Hacks note), so confirm on the event's own page before calendaring.

proposals.name: Cal High College & Career Center — Summer Opportunities
proposals.why: Ridhi's own school curates STEM research programs and internships here with deadlines — separate page from the already-covered Volunteer & Job Opportunities list.
proposals.eligibility_note: High school. Currently lists Summer SAGE (ages 14-17, LLNL/SLAC), SPARK stem-cell lab internship, LLNL Biotech Summer Experience (16+, entering grades 11-12) and USDA AgDiscovery. Page dating is mixed — some 2025 deadlines still shown — so treat listings as pointers, not current dates.

proposals.name: Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley (Pleasanton) — Volunteer Services
proposals.why: Closest hospital volunteer program to San Ramon and not yet on the list — the natural next step once Ridhi turns 16.
proposals.eligibility_note: GATE: minimum age 16, plus a 6-month / 100-hour commitment. Ridhi is 15, so this is a watchlist item, not a now item. The page also states plainly that volunteers do not shadow, observe, provide clinical services, or join research — so it builds hours, not lab exposure.

proposals.name: Contra Costa Library — San Ramon + Dougherty Station branch events
proposals.why: Narrows the already-covered county-wide BiblioCommons feed (364 events) to the two San Ramon branches, which is where the actual attendable teen programming is.
proposals.eligibility_note: Teen programming here is tagged 13-18, so Ridhi qualifies and Dhruv (11) does not yet; Dougherty Station's other listings in this window skew to preschool. Worth scanning for tween/grades 6-8 items as they appear.
